concepts.reader_question: Which records travel with the lot at a partner handoff?
concepts.description: Create one finished square native PNG minimum1080 each edge. Print only exact approved artwork_text and official logo; caption/native headline/alt/internal instructions remain outside raster. All background papers and records completely blank: no microglyphs, charts, record labels, dates or values. No ticks, seals, badges or completed-state symbols. Use photographic material daylight office and appropriate semiconductor cues with integrated varied diagrams, stable official header/category/sequence and strong readable blue/navy headline/body. No simplistic flat template or fixed layout percentages. Keep text uncluttered. Closing regional/context/source text must be comfortably legible at317px image display, approximately body type, with generous allocated space. Oblique daylight office scene, a matte semiconductor carrier at the boundary between two separated pale material surfaces. Blank translucent record sleeves accompany the carrier but stop in an open handoff zone; grounded connectors pose a relationship to review, not completed delivery.

F3-A1.headline: Chuyển đối tác, đã rõ dữ liệu đi cùng?
F3-A1.body: Khi một lô chuyển giữa các đối tác gia công, nhóm vận hành và chất lượng cần hỏi thông tin nào đi cùng lô và ai xác nhận tại điểm bàn giao.

concepts.description: Create one finished square native PNG minimum1080 each edge. Print only exact approved artwork_text and official logo; caption/native headline/alt/internal instructions remain outside raster. All background papers and records completely blank: no microglyphs, charts, record labels, dates or values. No ticks, seals, badges or completed-state symbols. Use photographic material daylight office and appropriate semiconductor cues with integrated varied diagrams, stable official header/category/sequence and strong readable blue/navy headline/body. No simplistic flat template or fixed layout percentages. Keep text uncluttered. Closing regional/context/source text must be comfortably legible at317px image display, approximately body type, with generous allocated space. Wide bright office composition with a grounded three-part material relationship around a semiconductor die tile. Open connectors retain pending review. Reserve a large clean regional/source panel as prominent readable text, using approximately body-sized type at317px image display; no tiny footer.
